title: GSTR-1 Filing (Monthly)
applicableTo: All GST registered businesses with turnover > ₹5 Cr
penaltyInfo: ₹50/day (₹20/day for nil return), max ₹10,000
notes: Outward supply return. Due on 11th of following month.

title: GSTR-3B Filing (Monthly)
applicableTo: All GST registered businesses with monthly filing
penaltyInfo: ₹50/day (₹20/day for nil return), max ₹10,000 + 18% interest on tax due
notes: Summary return with tax payment. Due on 20th of following month.

title: GSTR-9 Annual Return
applicableTo: All GST registered businesses with turnover > ₹2 Cr
penaltyInfo: ₹200/day (₹100 CGST + ₹100 SGST), max 0.50% of turnover
notes: Annual return consolidating all monthly/quarterly returns.

title: CMP-08 Composition Scheme Return
applicableTo: GST composition scheme dealers
penaltyInfo: ₹50/day (₹20/day for nil return), max ₹10,000
notes: Due on 18th of month following the quarter. Quarterly payment with annual return.

title: TDS Return Filing (Form 24Q/26Q/27Q)
applicableTo: All entities deducting TDS
penaltyInfo: ₹200/day u/s 234E until return is filed; penalty u/s 271H: ₹10,000 to ₹1,00,000
notes: Q1: Jul 31, Q2: Oct 31, Q3: Jan 31, Q4: May 31.

title: Advance Tax — 1st Installment
applicableTo: All businesses with estimated tax liability > ₹10,000 in a year
penaltyInfo: Interest u/s 234B (1% per month on shortfall) and 234C (1% per month on deferment)
notes: 15% of advance tax by Jun 15; 45% by Sep 15; 75% by Dec 15; 100% by Mar 15.

title: Advance Tax — 2nd Installment
applicableTo: All businesses with estimated tax liability > ₹10,000 in a year
penaltyInfo: Interest u/s 234B and 234C
notes: Cumulative 45% of advance tax due by Sep 15.

title: Advance Tax — 3rd Installment
applicableTo: All businesses with estimated tax liability > ₹10,000 in a year
penaltyInfo: Interest u/s 234B and 234C
notes: Cumulative 75% of advance tax due by Dec 15.

title: Advance Tax — 4th Installment
applicableTo: All businesses with estimated tax liability > ₹10,000 in a year
penaltyInfo: Interest u/s 234B and 234C
notes: 100% of advance tax due by Mar 15.

title: Income Tax Return Filing (Non-Audit)
applicableTo: Individuals, HUFs, firms (non-audit cases) for FY 2025-26
penaltyInfo: Late fee u/s 234F: ₹5,000 (₹1,000 if income < ₹5 Lakh); Interest u/s 234A at 1% per month
notes: For businesses requiring audit: Oct 31. For transfer pricing cases: Nov 30.

title: Income Tax Return Filing (Audit Cases)
applicableTo: Companies and firms requiring tax audit (turnover > ₹1 Cr / ₹10 Cr with digital transactions)
penaltyInfo: Late fee u/s 234F: ₹5,000; Interest u/s 234A at 1% per month; Penalty for non-audit u/s 271B: 0.5% of turnover or ₹1.5 Lakh (lower)
notes: Tax audit report (Form 3CA/3CB/3CD) due by Sep 30.

title: Tax Audit Report Filing
applicableTo: Businesses with turnover > ₹1 Cr (₹10 Cr for digital transactions > 95%)
penaltyInfo: Penalty u/s 271B: 0.5% of turnover or ₹1,50,000, whichever is lower
notes: Must be filed before ITR due date of Oct 31.

title: MCA Annual Return (MGT-7/MGT-7A)
applicableTo: All companies registered under Companies Act 2013
penaltyInfo: ₹100/day per default, max ₹5 Lakh for company and ₹50,000-₹5 Lakh for officers in default
notes: Due within 60 days of AGM. MGT-7A for OPCs and small companies.

title: MCA Financial Statements (AOC-4)
applicableTo: All companies registered under Companies Act 2013
penaltyInfo: ₹100/day per default for company; additional penalty for officers in default
notes: Due within 30 days of AGM. Includes balance sheet, P&L, cash flow statement.

title: DIR-3 KYC (Director KYC)
applicableTo: All directors with DIN who held directorship as on March 31
penaltyInfo: DIN marked as deactivated; ₹5,000 late fee for reactivation via DIR-3 KYC
notes: Annual KYC for directors. DIR-3 KYC web for no-change cases.

title: EPFO Contribution Payment
applicableTo: All establishments with 20+ employees (10+ for certain industries)
penaltyInfo: Interest @ 12% p.a. on delayed payment; damages up to 100% of arrears under Section 14B
notes: Due on 15th of following month. ECR filing + challan payment.

title: ESIC Contribution Payment
applicableTo: All establishments with 10+ employees where employee wages ≤ ₹21,000/month
penaltyInfo: Interest @ 12% p.a. on delayed payment; damages up to 25% of contribution
notes: Due on 15th of following month. Employer 3.25% + Employee 0.75%.

title: Professional Tax Payment
applicableTo: Employers and self-employed professionals in states that levy professional tax (Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Gujarat, AP, Telangana, WB, etc.)
penaltyInfo: Varies by state; generally 1-2% per month interest on delayed payment
notes: Monthly/annual depending on state. Max ₹2,500 per annum. Dates vary by state.

title: FSSAI Annual Return
applicableTo: All FSSAI licensed food business operators
penaltyInfo: Up to ₹5 Lakh penalty; license suspension or cancellation for non-compliance
notes: Annual return for FY ending March 31. Required for license renewal.

title: Shops & Establishment License Renewal
applicableTo: All commercial establishments, shops, hotels, restaurants, theatres
penaltyInfo: Varies by state; fine for operating without valid registration
notes: Validity period varies: 1-5 years depending on state. Some states have lifetime validity.

title: GSTR-1 (Quarterly under QRMP)
applicableTo: GST registered businesses with turnover ≤ ₹5 Cr opting for QRMP scheme
penaltyInfo: ₹50/day (₹20/day for nil return), max ₹10,000
notes: Due on 13th of month following the quarter. IFF can be filed for first two months.

title: GSTR-9C Reconciliation Statement
applicableTo: GST registered businesses with turnover > ₹5 Cr
penaltyInfo: Same as GSTR-9
notes: Self-certified reconciliation between GSTR-9 and audited financial statements.

title: Udyam Re-registration / Update
applicableTo: All MSMEs previously registered under EM-I/EM-II/UAM must re-register under Udyam
penaltyInfo: Loss of MSME benefits and priority sector lending status
notes: Update turnover and investment data annually. Free of cost.

title: TDS Certificate — Form 16/16A Issuance
applicableTo: All employers/deductors who deducted TDS
penaltyInfo: Penalty of ₹100/day u/s 272A(2)(g) for non-issuance, max amount of TDS
notes: Form 16 for salary TDS due by Jun 15. Form 16A for non-salary due within 15 days of TDS return filing.
